definition_zh: 水手长（船上负责甲板与索具的资深水手）
definition_en: the ship's officer in charge of the deck crew, rigging, and anchors
core_image: 甲板上提着哨子指挥收帆的老水手
scene: 风暴将至，老水手长吹响哨子催促收帆。The boatswain ordered the crew to lower the sails.
sceneCN: 这里 boatswain 是「水手长」（第 1 个义项：主管甲板事务的资深水手官）；句意是水手长命令船员降下船帆。

derivatives.zh: 复合词，义为「高空作业吊板」

senses.title: The deck officer of a ship
senses.titleCN: 船上主管甲板的水手长
senses.definition: the senior crew member in charge of deck work, rigging, and anchors
senses.definitionCN: 负责甲板作业、索具与锚具的资深船员
senses.example: The boatswain ordered the crew to lower the sails.
senses.exampleCN: 水手长命令船员降下船帆。
senses.why: The word joins boat and swain, the old word for a servant or attendant.
senses.whyCN: 该词由 boat 与 swain（古义「仆从」）复合而成。

senses.title: The warrant rank in navies
senses.titleCN: 海军中的准尉水手长军衔
senses.definition: a warrant officer rank responsible for seamanship and deck crews
senses.definitionCN: 负责船艺与甲板班组的准尉军衔
senses.example: He rose from ordinary seaman to boatswain in twelve years.
senses.exampleCN: 他用十二年时间从普通水兵升到水手长。
senses.why: Militaries formalized the working role into a rank.
senses.whyCN: 海军把这一实务角色正式化为军衔。

senses.title: The holder of the boatswain's call
senses.definition: the crew member who pipes commands with the boatswain's whistle
senses.definitionCN: 以水手长哨发布号令的船员
senses.example: The boatswain piped all hands on deck.
senses.exampleCN: 水手长吹哨召集全员上甲板。
senses.why: Before loudspeakers, the pipe was the ship's voice.
senses.whyCN: 在有扩音器之前，哨声就是全船的声音。

senses.title: Supervisor of maintenance and rigging
senses.titleCN: 船体与索具保养负责人
senses.definition: the one responsible for upkeep of hull, deck gear, and lines
senses.definitionCN: 负责船体、甲板设备与缆绳保养的人
senses.example: The boatswain had the deck holystoned white.
senses.exampleCN: 水手长命人把甲板用磨石擦得雪白。
senses.why: Deck order was the boatswain's pride and duty.
senses.whyCN: 甲板的整洁是水手长的骄傲与职责。

senses.title: Leader of deck work songs and pace
senses.titleCN: 水手劳动号子的领唱与节拍者
senses.definition: the man who set the rhythm for hauling and heaving
senses.definitionCN: 为拉缆、绞盘等集体劳作定节奏的人
senses.example: The boatswain's chant timed every pull of the halyard.
senses.exampleCN: 水手长的号子为每一次拉缆定拍。
senses.why: Heavy lines move only in rhythm; the leader sang the time.
senses.whyCN: 沉重的缆绳唯有合着节奏才能拉动，领唱者掌握时间。

senses.title: A dramatic stock character
senses.definition: the gruff sea officer as a stock figure in literature and opera
senses.definitionCN: 文学与歌剧中粗声粗气的海上管事角色
senses.example: The opera's boatswain storms about the stage bellowing orders.
senses.exampleCN: 歌剧中那位水手长在台上咆哮着发号施令。
senses.why: Shakespeare's Tempest opened with this shouting figure.
senses.whyCN: 莎士比亚《暴风雨》即以这位喝令者开场。

senses.title: Inshore boat handler
senses.definition: the crew member handling small boats and their crews
senses.definitionCN: 负责小艇及其艇员调度的人
senses.example: The boatswain crewed the launch for the shore party.
senses.exampleCN: 水手长为登陆组调配了汽艇人手。
senses.why: Boat in the word recalls the smaller craft under his care.
senses.whyCN: 词中的 boat 正对应他辖下的那些小艇。

senses.title: Modern coastguard and yacht usage
senses.titleCN: 现代海岸警卫队与游艇用法
senses.definition: the deck boss of a modern patrol boat or large yacht
senses.definitionCN: 现代巡逻艇或大型游艇上的甲板主管
senses.example: The yacht's boatswain checked every line before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴来临前，游艇水手长检查了每一根缆绳。
senses.why: Old titles survive wherever decks still need masters.
senses.whyCN: 凡有甲板需要管家之处，古老的头衔便存活至今。

intro.en: Boatswain joins boat with the old English swain, a servant or young man.
intro.cn: boatswain 由 boat 与古英语 swain「仆从、青年」复合而成。

items.en: swain traces to a Germanic word for a young man or attendant.
items.cn: swain 可追溯至日耳曼语中表示「青年、侍从」的词。

items.en: swan meant swain, boy, servant; bat was boat.
items.cn: 古英语 swān 意为「仆从、少年」，bat 意为「船」。

items.en: batswegen named the ship's servant officer.
items.cn: 晚期古英语 batswegen 指船上执事的仆役长。

items.en: bosun and botsen spellings show the swallowed vowel.
items.cn: 中古英语 bosun、botsen 等拼法显示中间音节被吞没。

items.en: spelled boatswain but pronounced bosun in sea speech.
items.cn: 今拼作 boatswain，海员口中读作 bosun。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the swain element and sound-alikes; the near-meaning group gathers ship officers.
note.cn: 形近组含 swain 成分与音近词；近义组收船上职务类词。

entries.definition: a country lover; a servant of old
entries.definitionCN: 乡野情郎；古义仆从——同根成分
舵手——同含 -swain 的复合词
水手长（口语拼法）——同词异拼

entries.definition: the same officer in nautical slang
entries.definitionCN: 水手长（航海俚语）——同义词

normalIntro.en: Boatswain is boat plus swain, the ship's old servant, said as bosun.
normalIntro.cn: boatswain 即 boat 加 swain「船上的老仆」，读作 bosun。

normal.en: The pronunciation is BOH-sun, never boat-swain.
normal.cn: 读音是 BOH-sun，切勿按拼写直读。

normal.en: Bosun is the accepted informal spelling.
normal.cn: bosun 是公认的口语拼法。

normal.en: The whistle is called the boatswain's call.
He is senior deck hand, not the captain.
normal.cn: 他是甲板资深海员，并非船长。

abstract.en: See a silver whistle glinting on a broad tattooed chest.
abstract.cn: 看银哨在布满纹身的宽阔胸前闪光。

abstract.en: Hear the pipe's three rising notes call all hands.
abstract.cn: 听哨音三声上扬召集全员。

abstract.en: Feel the deck tremble as a hundred feet run at the pipe's call.
abstract.cn: 感受哨响时百人奔甲板的震动。

examples.en: The boatswain ordered the crew to lower the sails.
examples.cn: 水手长命令船员降下船帆。

examples.en: The boatswain piped all hands on deck.
examples.cn: 水手长吹哨召集全员上甲板。

examples.en: The yacht's boatswain checked every line before the storm.
examples.cn: 风暴来临前，游艇水手长检查了每一根缆绳。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泊森」——船泊在港口时，森严号令全靠水手长一人，人称「泊森」。

root: boat「船」+ swain（古英语 swān「仆从、少年」，日耳曼词根）；晚期古英语 batswegen 指船上执事长，中古英语吞音为 bosun，今拼写 boatswain 而读音保持 /ˈbəʊsn/。

sensesIntro.en: From serving boy of the boat to the navy's deck boss, the boatswain owns the ship's working deck.
sensesIntro.cn: 从船上的杂役少年到海军的甲板主管，boatswain 始终是船舶甲板的管事人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a silver boatswain's call gleaming on the deck
core.cn: 核心意象：甲板上闪光的银色水手长哨

branches.en: Command and care of the deck
The pipe and the work song

branches.cn: 小艇与沿用至今的旧职

intro.en: The compound pattern boat plus swain repeats in coxswain.
intro.cn: boat 加 swain 的复合模式在 coxswain 中重现。

latinIntro.cn: 日耳曼词根，无拉丁同族词。

items.meaning: steersman of a shell or boat
